plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row of this map, including every printed term total. The 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading ('Psychology map for 2026-2027') and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The map's printed disclaimer reads verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This extraction did not capture per-course prerequisite text, so no prereqs are recorded. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Psychology / Associate in Arts for Transfer / 60-63 units / 4 terms / to CSU' (PROGRAM 1/1). The map contains only the Bakersfield College segment; no CSU courses or terms are listed, so none are transcribed. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 and a plan total of 60-63 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Major List A' (3-4) and 'Statistics' (4-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. PSYC C1000 and PSYC B6 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded with category 'major'. PSYC B6 carries a 'Prerequisites' label in Card View with no prerequisite course or text shown; none is recorded. The 'Major List A', 'Major List B' and 'Statistics' slots are printed with the label 'Major / Gen Ed' and 'Major List C' with 'Major'; all are recorded as major choice slots (codes BC-LISTA-1, BC-LISTB-1, BC-LISTC-1, BC-STAT-1). Terms 2 and 4 each print a single 'CSU Transferable Elective' slot at 5 units, exactly as printed in both views; each is recorded as one 5-unit elective choice slot (codes BC-ELEC-2 and BC-ELEC-4).
